entries.title: Psalms 10:1
segments: ¶Why do You stand afar off, O LORD? [Why] do You hide in times of trouble?

entries.title: Psalms 10:2
segments: The wicked in [his] pride persecutes the poor; Let them be caught in the plots which they have devised.

entries.title: Psalms 10:3
segments: For the wicked boasts of his heart's desire; He blesses the greedy [and] renounces the LORD.

entries.title: Psalms 10:4
segments: The wicked in his proud countenance does not seek [God]; God [is] in none of his thoughts.

entries.title: Psalms 10:5
segments: His ways are always prospering; Your judgments [are] far above, out of his sight; [As for] all his enemies, he sneers at them.

entries.title: Psalms 10:6
segments: He has said in his heart, "I shall not be moved; I shall never be in adversity."

entries.title: Psalms 10:7
segments: His mouth is full of cursing and deceit and oppression; Under his tongue [is] trouble and iniquity.

entries.title: Psalms 10:8
segments: He sits in the lurking places of the villages; In the secret places he murders the innocent; His eyes are secretly fixed on the helpless.

entries.title: Psalms 10:9
segments: He lies in wait secretly, as a lion in his den; He lies in wait to catch the poor; He catches the poor when he draws him into his net.

entries.title: Psalms 10:10
segments: So he crouches, he lies low, That the helpless may fall by his strength.

entries.title: Psalms 10:11
segments: He has said in his heart, "God has forgotten; He hides His face; He will never see."

entries.title: Psalms 10:12
segments: ¶Arise, O LORD! O God, lift up Your hand! Do not forget the humble.

entries.title: Psalms 10:13
segments: Why do the wicked renounce God? He has said in his heart, "You will not require [an account]."

entries.title: Psalms 10:14
segments: But You have seen, for You observe trouble and grief, To repay [it] by Your hand. The helpless commits himself to You; You are the helper of the fatherless.

entries.title: Psalms 10:15
segments: Break the arm of the wicked and the evil [man]; Seek out his wickedness [until] You find none.

entries.title: Psalms 10:16
segments: The LORD [is] King forever and ever; The nations have perished out of His land.

entries.title: Psalms 10:17
segments: LORD, You have heard the desire of the humble; You will prepare their heart; You will cause Your ear to hear,

entries.title: Psalms 10:18
segments: To do justice to the fatherless and the oppressed, That the man of the earth may oppress no more.
